name: Speaking In Tongue Jesus
overview: The topic of 'Speaking In Tongue Jesus' highlights the biblical reality of God communicating through diverse languages, as foretold in Isaiah 28:11 where God speaks with stammering lips and another tongue. This prophecy finds fulfillment in Acts 2 during Pentecost, when the Holy Spirit enabled the believers to speak in various languages, causing those who heard to recognize their own native tongues (Acts 2:1, 6). These passages underscore God's sovereign work in using different languages to spread the gospel and confirm His presence among His people.
